method: Manual review and rewrite of each affected simplified descendant, atomization of two matching traditional roots, and three paired traditional target corrections.

roots.reason: 岂 is the simplified form of 豈. The lexical card should teach the common function how, while descendants should reuse the same concrete victory-drum image as 豈 rather than the abstract phrase victorious music.
尔 is the simplified form of 爾 and means you, not those. A stable atomic unit also avoids forcing a misleading small-component story into every descendant.
Nineteen cards already reuse 爾 as one coherent unit, so the root should teach that same unit rather than expand into four low-value pieces.
卖 is the simplified form of 賣 and means sell. Betray was an unrelated narrative gloss that distorted ten descendants.
Eighteen cards already reuse 賣 as one coherent sell unit, so the root should match that recurring boundary.
黾 is the simplified form of the toad pictograph 黽. The rare verbal sense strive is much less useful than the visible animal image across its descendants.

evidence.supports: 岂/豈, 尔/爾, 卖/賣, and 黾/黽 are explicit simplified/traditional pairs; 黾/黽 is identified as a toad pictograph.
